_comment: UAT checklist IDs that are covered by a test whose title does not name the ID (workflow steps, combined tests). UatTraceabilityTest checks that every entry points at an existing spec containing the quoted test title, so the map cannot go stale. An ID that a test names in its own title (for example 'FIN-02 ...') needs no entry. Map an ID only to a test that really covers it.
